title: Mobile-MMLU: A Mobile Intelligence Language Understanding Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Testing model performance variations by systematically placing the ground truth answer in different multiple-choice positions (A, B, C, D) and comparing the results against randomized distributions to measure inherent positional preferences.

Observing the tendency of models (especially mobile-level LLMs) to select the longest option more frequently, which was evaluated during dataset construction and mitigated by ensuring incorrect options are equal to or longer than the correct answers.
